description: A sixteen-track, sixty-four-step drum sequencer of 128 patterns: fifteen instrument tracks and an accent track, run from an outside 32 PPQN clock, sending triggers or its own drum machine audio

params.text: Selects the drum machine for the selected instrument track, which matters when the outputs are set to Audio Engine
Selects the kit piece within that drum machine for the selected instrument track; the choice offered follows the nature of the track
Sets the last step of the pattern, from 1 to 64; with tracks soloed it sets the last step of those tracks alone, which is how polyrhythms are built
Sends the pattern back to its first step
Repeats the playing step or bar while held; how much is repeated is set by the "LOOP" button behavior menu, and the button does nothing while +2V or more is held on the LOOP jack
Plays the pattern backwards while held

inputs.text: Takes the clock, which must be 32 pulses per quarter note; the panel prints X32 above the jack because that is the multiplier to set on the clock module
A trigger starts or pauses the sequencer
A trigger sends the pattern back to its first step
Shifts the last step up or down from the number set by the LAST STEP encoder, by voltage
While +2V or more is held here every playing track repeats: +2V to +5V the current step, +5V to +9.99V two steps, +10V the bar. The LOOP button does nothing while this jack is high
While +2V or more is held here, the pattern plays backwards
While +2V or more is held here, the pattern plays to the last step and back again; it is ignored while LOOP is active
Sets the swing applied to the even steps of the whole pattern, 50% and no swing at 0V rising to 75% at +10V; the FroeZe-SX expander switches this jack off
A trigger steps back one pattern. With the NEXT jack empty this jack instead takes a 0V to +10V voltage and selects the pattern outright
A trigger steps on one pattern

outputs.text: Carries that track's steps as a +10V 1ms trigger, or its drum machine audio when the Outputs menu is Audio Engine; an accented step sends -10V unless the FroeZe-X expander is attached
Carries the accent track's own steps as a +10V 1ms trigger

notes: nothing plays until a 32 PPQN clock reaches the CLK jack; with none patched the black NO CLOCK indicator blinks and the timing of the displays goes erratic.
the grid is worked like a touchscreen: a left click on an empty cell writes a note, a second click accents it, a third makes it a ratchet, and Ctrl or Command with a left click empties it
a left click on a track name selects that track and a second left click solos it; a right click selects it and a second right click mutes it. Solo and mute belong to the pattern
clicking the Ohmer logo dims or brightens every display, on the module and on any attached expander.
a right-side FroeZe-X expander gives the accents their own sixteen output jacks, in place of the -10V the main outputs otherwise send for them, and adds pattern and track editing.
a left-side FroeZe-SX expander gives each instrument track its own swing CV and switches off the %SWING jack on this module.
without an OhmerPrems licence keyfile only the BD, SD, CH, OH and AC tracks and pattern 1 can be edited, and five drum machines sound: Oberheim DMX, Drumulator, LinnDrum, 707 and 808
a right click on a grid cell opens an on-screen menu for that cell; no part of the grid can be clicked for help, because the whole grid is one widget
menu: Outputs: Triggers (default), Audio Engine (QuadPercs sounds) — chooses whether the sixteen jacks send triggers or the drum machine audio of the internal QuadPercs engines
"LOOP" button behavior: 1/16 step repeat (default), 1/8, 1/4 beat repeat — sets how much of the pattern the LOOP button repeats
File — holds Open and Save as for three things: Pattern, Drum Kits and Ratchet slots
